hardware.gpu: 2 x NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti 22 GiB, SM75, NVLink

baseline_description: Previous Q2 expert/Dense optimization, freshly rerun in this experiment

configuration.warmup: one 512-token decode run per chunk, one prefill run; three formal runs per group

timing.memory_peak: nvidia-smi every two seconds; short peaks may be missed

changes: Q3_K byte-permute sub-scale decoding and packed sign extension, preserving the four-group dot order
Eight output rows per CUDA block for at least 1024 rows and K <= 8192; shared Q8 input
Optimized decoding with the legacy four-warps-per-row schedule for smaller projections and long K
Single input row only; guarded dimensions/alignment and existing fallback; no environment variable or persistent workspace

dense_replay.method: Public Linear with real Q3_K packed blocks repeated/cropped to each shape and synthetic nonzero input explicitly copied to CUDA; FP32/FP16/BF16, partial rows, 1/3/8 input rows, admission boundaries. CUDA events over graph replays; clocks uncontrolled.

ncu.method: Actual Q3_K 5120 x 2560 projection and synthetic nonzero FP16 activation; GPU0, cold cache, kernel replay, clocks uncontrolled; hardware traffic is not merely weight bytes divided by duration

limitations: Performance and sanitizer tests use SM75; no cross-architecture speed guarantee.
Clock frequencies were not locked; tiny operator differences and the small prefill difference are not established gains.
Profiling has overhead; end-to-end throughput comes from unprofiled runs.
Identical outputs are demonstrated for these test cases, not all possible model prompts.
